notes.subject: other
notes.text: Traffic drives on the left, on an island in the Atlantic north of the Caribbean.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Black car with the whole front sides typically visible.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Most roads have one solid yellow centre line and no edge lines.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Single-family stone houses in pastel colours, almost always with bright white roofs.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: All-white, fairly long plates with black digits bunched toward the middle.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: White zigzag road lines appear now and then.

notes.subject: vegetation
notes.text: Dense, low vegetation of small trees and many bushes, with houses scattered about.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: You are never far from the sea, and the water often looks distinctly light blue.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The biggest town has a dense downtown with many large multi-storey buildings.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The northwest tip has many large buildings of unpainted grey brick.

notes.subject: coverage
notes.text: A boat trekker on the east coast goes around a harbour past a fort on the northeast tip.
